title: Latency and timeouts on api-gateway

detection.alert: api-gateway: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-08-26 08:35-12:15: api-gateway: 189 of 278 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-08-26 08:35 and 2026-08-26 12:15 UTC (peak error ratio 0.89 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 28.024 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of compute-svc removed exponential backoff from ResourceManager calls; combined with retry.max raised earlier it created a retry storm.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) replaces exponential backoff with a constant BASE_BACKOFF_MS.
_templates.remediation: Roll back compute-svc {version_to} -> {version_from}; restore `backoffMs = Math.min(backoffMs * 2, MAX_BACKOFF_MS)` at {file}:{line}; revert retry.max to its previous value.

rca.macro: Deploy v2.37.0 of compute-svc removed exponential backoff from ResourceManager calls; combined with retry.max raised earlier it created a retry storm.
rca.micro: compute/rpc/RMClient.java:62 (RMClient.allocate) replaces exponential backoff with a constant BASE_BACKOFF_MS.
rca.remediation: Roll back compute-svc v2.37.0 -> v2.36.0; restore `backoffMs = Math.min(backoffMs * 2, MAX_BACKOFF_MS)` at compute/rpc/RMClient.java:62; revert retry.max to its previous value.

action_items: Add a regression test covering RMClient.allocate (compute/rpc/RMClient.java).
Alert on the error signature `GET <*> <*> <*> target=cloud-api`.
